name: Moonshot Kimi
label: Moonshot Kimi
description: Official Kimi Open Platform Chat Completions on the v2 agent model contract (INPUT llm_input → OUTPUT llm_output). operation selects chat, analyze_image (same POST /v1/chat/completions with multimodal parts), or list_models (GET /v1/models). Auth is StudioQuack secret api_key sent as Bearer. Intl host api.moonshot.ai vs China api.moonshot.cn — keys are not interchangeable. File/image/video use type file. Docs: https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/api/overview. Terms: https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/agreement/modeluse. Never log api_key.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: llm_input
ports.description: v2 LLM request so this node can sit on the AI Agent model FUNCTION port. Shape: {messages, tools?, stream?, model?, file?}. Moonshot does not fetch public HTTPS image URLs — use data URI or ms://file_id after Files upload. Image/video use type file (platform ref-id). Do not put api_key here.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT: chat | analyze_image | list_models. Example: chat.

schema.label: messages
schema.description: Conversation for chat / analyze_image. content may be string or {type:text|image_url|video_url}. Keep reasoning_content on historical assistant turns when thinking is on. Example: [{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}].

schema.label: tools
schema.description: Optional function tools for chat. Omit or [] sends no tools.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Platform file ref-id for analyze_image (jpeg/png/gif/webp/bmp/heic/heif; video mp4/mpeg/mov/avi/webm). Never inline bytes. Public HTTPS image URLs are not supported by Moonshot.

schema.label: inputFiles
schema.description: user-uploaded files and voice clips for the model

children.label: kind
children.description: File kind: image, document, audio, or video.

children.label: mime_type
children.description: RFC 1521 media type, e.g. application/pdf, image/png

children.label: source
children.description: How the payload is carried: base64 or url.

children.label: data
children.description: base64-encoded payload (when source=base64) or absolute URL (when source=url)

children.label: name
children.description: Original filename, surfaced as the upload name

schema.label: tool_choice
schema.description: Request-body parameter `tool_choice` for operation: chat.

schema.label: temperature
schema.description: Request-body parameter `temperature` for operation: chat.

schema.label: top_p
schema.description: Request-body parameter `top_p` for operation: chat.

schema.label: n
schema.description: Request-body parameter `n` for operation: chat.

schema.label: max_completion_tokens
schema.description: Request-body parameter `max_completion_tokens` for operations: chat, analyze_image.

schema.label: presence_penalty
schema.description: Request-body parameter `presence_penalty` for operation: chat.

schema.label: frequency_penalty
schema.description: Request-body parameter `frequency_penalty` for operation: chat.

schema.label: stop
schema.description: Request-body parameter `stop` for operation: chat.

schema.label: response_format
schema.description: Request-body parameter `response_format` for operation: chat.

schema.label: thinking
schema.description: Request-body parameter `thinking` for operations: chat, analyze_image.

schema.label: reasoning_effort
schema.description: Request-body parameter `reasoning_effort` for operations: chat, analyze_image.

ports.name: llm_output
ports.description: v2 LLM response envelope. Success includes status/data from OfficialApiNode. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed Kimi JSON (chat message with optional reasoning_content, or models list).

schema.label: result
schema.description: canonical assistant payload {role,content,tool_calls?,output_files?,…}

schema.label: outputFiles
schema.description: files produced by the model, e.g. generated images/audio

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official Kimi verb. EXACT values: chat | analyze_image | list_models. chat and analyze_image share POST /v1/chat/completions.

configurationParameters.label: API Key
configurationParameters.description: Kimi Open Platform API key. Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Intl (platform.kimi.ai) and China (platform.kimi.com) keys are not interchangeable. StudioQuack secret binding only. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Model
configurationParameters.description: Default kimi-k3 (current flagship). Other current ids: kimi-k2.7-code, kimi-k2.7-code-highspeed, kimi-k2.6, kimi-k2.5. moonshot-v1-* sunsets 2026-08-31 for new users. kimi-k2 series discontinued 2026-05-25. Docs: https://platform.moonshot.ai/docs/models .

configurationParameters.label: Base URL
configurationParameters.description: HTTPS. Intl default https://api.moonshot.ai/v1. China: https://api.moonshot.cn/v1. Match the console that issued the key. Interpolated as api_spec baseUrl.

configurationParameters.label: Stream
configurationParameters.description: Purpose: controls whether Moonshot Kimi requests a streamed completion and fans live deltas through helper emitPartial. Canonical flag. When true the node POSTs stream:true, parses SSE data: lines, emitPartial("thinking", delta) for reasoning/thinking and emitPartial("answer", delta) for content; thoughts also appear on llm_output.result.thoughts / thinking; finish_reason, usage and tool_calls are assembled at the end. Accepted: select true | false. Default: true. Invalid/blank → true. Example: true.
